purpose: Independent sensitivity study for registered original replays that cannot be reproduced on the unmodified 0.01a trial.
qualification: Apply the existing native input, frame coverage and camera gates unchanged to every source × stage. Include every qualified registered stage. Exclude a stage only after independent genuine attempts including ordinary Stage Select and uninterrupted natural play where available establish reproducible early termination/desynchronization, with source/attempt hashes and observed evidence. An SSH failure, incomplete download, busy host, source age or policy score cannot justify exclusion.
completeness: Before fitting, all original 45 registered source stages must carry qualified or documented reproducible-unplayable status. Preserve split and pilot groups. No external replay is substituted.
arms: Retail rehearsal versus the same retail examples plus all qualifying exact-build TRAIN stages. Same starting weights, sampler, update count and learning rates as the original protocol. Separate retail and exact-build HELD scores; disclose the missing pilot/shot/stage combinations.
relationship: If all 45 reproduce there is no secondary run. Any narrower result remains explicitly separate from the original 45-stage experiment.
